strikes.name: Service Defect Freeze
strikes.argument: No proof of service on Nordskog Properties means no jurisdiction over that defendant; no deadlines triggered.
strikes.effect: You are not late. You are early.

strikes.name: §654.2A / §654A Mediation Defect
strikes.argument: No agricultural mediation certificate = premature filing = dismissal; burden on plaintiff.
strikes.effect: Forces RSB to prove mediation satisfaction; potential dismissal or limited stay of 40-acre parcel.
strikes.timing: File MTD before answer; Friday 3:30-4:30 PM window

strikes.name: Note / Standing
strikes.law: Iowa R. Civ. P. 1.961; UCC Article 3 (Iowa Code Ch. 554)
strikes.argument: Demand original note and complete chain of assignment; failure = no enforcement right.

strikes.name: Accounting Collapse
strikes.argument: Demand full payment history + fee basis; dispute amount destroys SJ viability.
strikes.effect: Prevents clean summary judgment; forces evidentiary hearing on amount due.

kill_zone.strategy: Demand FMV determination before deficiency hearing; introduce appraisal showing FMV ≥ debt → deficiency = $0 as matter of law.
